decision.comment: Validated 2026-09-15: OVERRIDE foundation 298.8 (heavy-soak artifact) AND rejected sr_legacy 54 (pristine untreated - a frame the IQF customer cannot buy) -> CoFID 16-372 91 mg (DH-2013 analysed program), the retail light-dip class. Bag panel 88.5/100g (3% off); class cluster BLS 72 / FCDB 76 / MEXT 110. Untreated floor 54 / heavy-soak ceiling 299. Shahab-directed correction
decision.resolution: Retail-class arbitration (Shahab 2026-09-14): bag panel + all four foreign retail tables (72-110) agree against both USDA frames; US untreated 54 is frame-defective for the IQF product class (every IQF bag carries at least a dip - this one declares it). CoFID 91 = DH-2013 analysed, same program as the chloride adoption.
